description: One venue event as served by the venue layer (S5, contract 12 finding 4 disposition): the record's own fields — at, kind, tone, message, venue — plus the LogRow split served natively as first-class fields (date_token, time, headline), so no consumer re-derives the split. meta and entity carry only what the record itself serves; both are null when the record names no actor or entity (honest absence).

date_token.description: Compact served date token for the timeline row (e.g. 'Nov 13'), derived from the record's own timestamp by the venue layer's one derivation (sync/venue_events.py).

entity.description: The session or entity the event names, when the record serves one; the timeline drawer's routing row resolves over it.

headline.description: The message verbatim — the timeline row's headline; wrapping is the row's act, never a truncation here.

meta.description: The timeline row's meta attribution (actor as served), or null when the record serves none.

time.description: The record's time of day as served for the split (e.g. '2:02 PM'), derived with date_token.

title: Venue event (served, with the LogRow split)
